title: Positivity of Saito's Eta Products
statement: For every natural number $h$, does the eta product $\eta(h\tau)^{\varphi(h)}\prod_{d\mid h}\eta(d\tau)^{-\mu(d)}$ have only nonnegative Fourier coefficients? In particular, prove or disprove this conjecture when $h$ is divisible by at least two distinct primes.
